hero.title: Christ Is The Answer
hero.subtitle: A family of faith serving God and the community
hero.tagline: A Place of Faith, Hope & Love
hero.description: Join our community as we worship together, grow in faith, and serve one another. Everyone is welcome here.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: To Our Family of Faith
welcome.description: We are a community of believers committed to sharing the love of Christ. We invite you to be part of our family.
welcome.description2: Our church is a place where you can find meaningful relationships, grow in your faith, and discover your purpose. We believe that everyone has a place here, and we can't wait to meet you.

upcomingEvents.title: Upcoming Events
upcomingEvents.subtitle: Join our activities
upcomingEvents.description: Join us for worship, fellowship, and community gatherings. There's always something happening at our church.

ministries.title: Our Ministries
ministries.subtitle: Serving Everyone
ministries.description: We have ministries for all ages and stages of life.
ministries.fullDescription: We offer a variety of ministries to help you grow in your faith and connect with others.

cta.title: Have Questions?
cta.subtitle: We are here to help
cta.description: If you have questions about faith, the church, or how you can participate, don't hesitate to contact us.

getConnected.title: Get Connected
getConnected.description: Join a small group and experience authentic community. Find your place to belong and grow together.

give.title: Support Our Mission
give.description: Your generosity helps us serve our community, support missions, and share the love of Christ with others.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: We Want to Hear From You
contact.description: Have questions? We'd love to hear from you. Send us a message and we'll respond as soon as possible.
contact.name: Name
contact.subject: Subject
